issues.description: The advertised tiny extraction path still requires data/stories/manifest.json, which is absent, so make demo and integration fail.
The end-to-end tiny test currently fails at extraction because required story data is not checked in or generated.
Documentation advertises make demo as runnable, but the repo cannot regenerate the demo outputs as checked in.
Tiny steering ignores the supplied vector and hardcodes effects from emotion/category valence, so steering validation is not validating vectors.
Tiny extraction injects the target emotion label directly into activations via label_hint, making validation partly circular.
Vector manifests are not checked against the selected backend/model/layer dimensions, so wrong CLI flags can crash or produce invalid comparisons.
Preference steering loads vectors without validating backend/model/d_model compatibility before using them with a freshly created backend.
HF preference scoring is not pairwise despite the README claim; it computes one good-minus-bad score per activity and synthesizes pairwise Elo inputs.
Elo ratings depend on synthetic probabilities from independent logits and fixed pair order rather than real pairwise model comparisons.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still selects one principal component, which violates the expected no-op edge case.
Config values are cast but not validated, allowing empty emotions/topics or invalid fractions to fail later with unclear errors.
Validation does not handle unsupported emotion sets, empty scenarios, or one-emotion manifests, leading to crashes or NaN off-diagonal means.
HF residual extraction has no truncation, batching, or context-length guard, so long stories can exceed model limits or exhaust memory.
The HF backend loads the whole model then moves it to one device instead of using device_map/low-memory loading, increasing OOM risk.
HuggingFace model/tokenizer loading is unpinned by revision, which makes results and supply-chain posture non-reproducible.
Dependencies are only lower-bounded and no lockfile is present, so the environment is not reproducible.
